creator: Alexander Terp
description:
Agent state costs one held-open connection and one thread per pane (observations/herdr-0.8.0.md section 11). At 15 panes that is 16 of each, and nothing has measured what it costs in memory, file descriptors or scheduling.

The number decides two things: whether the upstream ask (a_27N6pklkl) is worth pressing, and whether the current thread-per-watcher shape should become one thread polling many sockets. Needs the splits work first, since that is what puts 15 panes in a window.
title: 📊 Budget the per-pane agent connections at 15 panes
